name: ReIn ∞ Alter
source:
"From the moment we are born, we are alone. And when we die, once more we lose everything and are alone."
Takamine Rei has been seeing a dream in which a girl he doesn't know commits suicide. Living peacefully together with his older sister, he yet is troubled by an unusual worry.
To Rei, who enjoys browsing internet articles and news that illustrate the despair inevitably lurking in this world, the 'everyday' is just an illusion, a stifling world built up from the lies of 'outward appearances'. He wants out.

Rei comes across news of a series of violent killings, which are rumored on the net to be the work of 'Demons'. After watching a classmate (and idol) Sasaki Kiraka's broadcast video about 'Demons', he decides to set out and find out whether these so-called 'Demons' truly exist or not.

This would be the beginning of the world's end, and the prologue to a story tracing back to the origins of humankind. Mysteries of "Demons", "Psychic powers <Rein>", "Alters" ーー and the "Demon Lord".
This is a story of the world's end and salvation; of loneliness and love.

[Translation of the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21657]offical description[/url]]
translation:
“从我们出生的那一刻起，我们就是孤独的。而当我们死去时，我们再次失去一切，变得孤独。”
高峰丽做了一个梦，梦中一个他不认识的女孩自杀了。与姐姐平静地生活在一起的他却被一种不寻常的担忧所困扰。
对于喜欢浏览网络文章和新闻的丽来说，这些文章和新闻揭示了这个世界上不可避免地潜伏着的绝望，“日常”只是一种幻觉，是一个由“外表”的谎言建立起来的令人窒息的世界。他想出去。

丽偶然发现了一系列暴力杀戮的消息，网络上有传言称这是“恶魔”所为。在观看了同学（兼偶像）佐佐木吉拉卡关于“恶魔”的广播视频后，他决定出发去查明这些所谓的“恶魔”是否真的存在。

这将是世界末日的开始，也是人类起源故事的序幕。“恶魔”、“精神力<缰绳>”、“Alters”ーー以及“魔王”之谜。
这是一个世界末日与救赎的故事；孤独和爱。

[[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21657]官方描述的翻译[/url]]
